title: Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding
summary: Brain encoding models aim to predict neural responses to stimuli. The most widely used approach fits readouts from frozen pretrained backbones. Using neural data to train large models from scratch or fully fine-tune them after task-pretraining has proven difficult because neural data is costly and limited. We show that parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables us to effectively adapt very large pretrained backbones for brain encoding with a small number of trainable parameters. To make it computationally practical, we exploit the backbone's causal structure to predict multiple timepoints in a single pass instead of using sliding windows, significantly reducing feature-extraction cost. This enables efficient fine-tuning of multimodal backbones with up to 104B parameters, the largest model adapted for brain encoding to our knowledge. Trained with a low-rank adapter (LoRA) and a lightweight readout, our approach consistently improves brain encoding performance across nine diverse multimodal backbones. On the same Qwen3-Omni backbone as the prior state-of-the-art (SoTA), our method BrainLoRA achieves the best published performance on the Algonauts 2025 Challenge. We also show the adapted multimodal backbones remain interpretable: modality attribution recovers the canonical sensory topography that prior work often obtains by construction from separate unimodal encoders, and neural adaptation increases the contribution of audio inputs and cross-modal mixing within the backbone. To scale out the number of adapted models, we develop a multi-LoRA kernel that accelerates joint training of multiple LoRAs on a shared backbone. This enables an ensemble of 200+ adapted models that ranks first on the public Algonauts post-challenge leaderboard at the time of writing. Together, our results highlight PEFT as an efficient and powerful paradigm for brain encoding.
translation:
标题：面向脑编码的参数高效微调规模化

摘要：脑编码模型旨在预测神经对刺激的响应。目前最广泛使用的方法是在冻结的预训练骨干网络上拟合读出层。由于神经数据昂贵且有限，利用神经数据从头训练大模型或在任务预训练后对其进行全参数微调已被证明十分困难。我们表明，参数高效微调（PEFT）使我们能够以少量可训练参数有效地将超大规模预训练骨干网络适配于脑编码。为使其在计算上可行，我们利用骨干网络的因果结构在一次前向中预测多个时间点，而非使用滑动窗口，从而显著降低特征提取成本。这使得能够高效微调参数量高达1040亿的多模态骨干网络；据我们所知，这是目前适配于脑编码的最大模型。我们的方法采用低秩适配器（LoRA）和轻量读出层进行训练，在九种不同的多模态骨干网络上持续提升脑编码性能。在与先前最先进（SoTA）方法相同的 Qwen3-Omni 骨干网络上，我们的方法 BrainLoRA 在 Algonauts 2025 挑战赛中取得了已发表的最佳性能。我们还表明，适配后的多模态骨干网络仍具有可解释性：模态归因恢复了经典的感觉拓扑，而先前工作通常通过从独立的单模态编码器构造来获得这一拓扑；神经适配增加了音频输入的贡献以及骨干网络内部的跨模态混合。为扩展适配模型的数量，我们开发了一种多 LoRA 内核，可加速在共享骨干网络上联合训练多个 LoRA。这支持由200多个适配模型组成的集成，在撰写本文时于公开的 Algonauts 赛后排行榜上排名第一。综上，我们的结果凸显了 PEFT 作为一种高效且强大的脑编码范式的价值。

title: Learning from Fleet Experience: A Collective Learning Paradigm for Robots
summary: Experience generated during deployment offers an opportunity for robots to improve policy reliability through learning from their own executions. However, learning through human corrections requires teleoperators to monitor execution and intervene when policies fail, a demand that is difficult to meet as robot fleets grow. We introduce collective experience learning (CEL), a learning paradigm in which deployed robots share their execution experience to improve a common policy. We realize CEL through failure-guided experience retrieval fine-tuning (FERT), which uses failure contexts from robot executions to retrieve relevant trajectory segments from the fleet's shared successful experience and uses their actions as supervision for policy updates, without collecting additional expert demonstrations or corrective actions. A fault-tolerant asynchronous training system (FATS) coordinates experience collection, policy optimization and policy distribution despite local interruptions within the robot fleet. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, the resulting policies achieve success rates of 93.3-99.2%, evaluated over 120 trials per task on robots excluded from training data collection. With collection time per robot held fixed, larger fleets provide more experience and FERT generally achieves higher success rates across the evaluated sizes. On multi-stage phone packaging, learning with 96 robots increases success from 79.2% to 98.3%. These results support collective experience as a practical basis for scalable robot learning and a path towards improving policy reliability during deployment without collecting additional expert corrective actions.
translation:
标题：从机群经验中学习：一种机器人集体学习范式

摘要：部署期间产生的经验为机器人提供了通过学习自身执行过程来提高策略可靠性的机会。然而，通过人工纠正进行学习需要远程操作员监控执行过程并在策略失败时进行干预，而随着机器人机群规模扩大，这一需求难以满足。我们提出集体经验学习（CEL），这是一种已部署机器人共享其执行经验以改进共同策略的学习范式。我们通过故障引导的经验检索微调（FERT）实现 CEL：该方法利用机器人执行中的失败情境，从机群共享的成功经验中检索相关轨迹片段，并将其动作作为策略更新的监督信号，而无需收集额外的专家演示或纠正动作。容错异步训练系统（FATS）在机器人机群出现局部中断时，仍能协调经验收集、策略优化和策略分发。在五个真实世界操作任务中，所得策略在未参与训练数据收集的机器人上、每个任务 120 次试验的评估中达到 93.3%–99.2% 的成功率。在每个机器人的收集时间保持固定的情况下，更大的机群提供更多经验，且 FERT 在所评估的规模上通常取得更高的成功率。在多阶段手机包装任务中，使用 96 个机器人进行学习可将成功率从 79.2% 提高到 98.3%。这些结果支持将集体经验作为可扩展机器人学习的实用基础，并表明其是一条在部署期间无需收集额外专家纠正动作即可提高策略可靠性的途径。

title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
summary: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately 1.86times end-to-end inference speedup and a 66times reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.
translation:
标题：MemT-1.0：迈向记忆原生演化

摘要：记忆原生演化要求将记忆转变为基础模型的内在能力，使其能够持续积累和利用信息。为此，我们推出MemT-1.0，这是一种将记忆内化为模型计算组成部分的记忆基础模型新架构。MemT-1.0基于Metis构建，采用Gated DeltaNet-2，并在每轮对话中引入稳定的token级记忆更新机制。我们进一步提出Mixture-of-Storage以扩展原生记忆容量。在经过审慎的主干准备之后，我们开发了包含持续预训练和后训练的两阶段训练流程，并由34B token的训练数据以及高效的训练与推理基础设施提供支撑。我们发布了包含MemT-1.0-Nano和MemT-1.0-Flash的模型系列，并对记忆能力和通用能力进行了全面评估。结果表明，它们在平均表现上优于参数化记忆基线，与检索增强方法相比仍具竞争力，同时 largely 保留了通用能力。在128K token的历史长度下，MemT-1.0-Nano相较完整上下文KV缓存实现了约1.86倍的端到端推理加速和66倍的持久存储缩减。通过内化检索到的程序性经验，MemT-1.0提升了智能体任务的任务成功率，为迈向记忆原生演化提供了切实可行的一步。

title: Holi-World: Building Holistic World Intelligence from Human-Ego Experience
summary: Human egocentric experience offers a rich foundation for learning how the world is organized and how it changes through interaction. Realizing this potential at scale requires turning growing volumes of recordings into learning resources that connect scene structure, object semantics, and interaction histories across viewpoints and time, while reducing dependence on costly manual annotation. We introduce HOLI-WORLD, an integrated ecosystem connecting experience capture, world representation, automated data construction, model learning, and independent evaluation. To sup- port learning at scale, HOLIWORLD-Foundry combines complementary static and dynamic perception to automatically construct world records that connect persistent scene structure and evolving object states with interaction histories and supporting observations. HOLIWORLD-Data organizes these records from approximately 100 self-collected scenes into grounded learning resources, including approximately 80K QA pairs used to train HOLIWORLD-VL-4B. Independent human annotations of heldout recordings form HOLIWORLD-Bench, supporting evaluation of both annotation quality and learned spatial and temporal understanding. Experiments on ScanNet, ScanNet++, Aria Digital Twin, and HOLIWORLD-Bench demonstrate strong performance in static perception and dynamic tracking, while training on HOLIWORLD-Data substantially improves HOLIWORLD-VL-4B's spatial and temporal reasoning on HOLI- WORLD-Bench and EgoDynamic4D. HOLIWORLD provides a practical foundation for expanding learning resources from the continuous flow of human experience and advancing machine understanding of the dynamic world.
translation:
标题：Holi-World：从人类自我中心经验构建整体世界智能

摘要：人类自我中心经验为学习世界如何组织以及如何通过交互发生变化提供了丰富基础。要大规模实现这一潜力，需要将不断增长的记录转化为学习资源，这些资源能够跨视角和时间连接场景结构、物体语义与交互历史，同时减少对昂贵人工标注的依赖。我们提出 HOLI-WORLD，一个连接经验采集、世界表示、自动化数据构建、模型学习和独立评估的集成生态系统。为支持大规模学习，HOLIWORLD-Foundry 结合互补的静态与动态感知，自动构建世界记录，将持久场景结构和不断演变的物体状态与交互历史及支持性观测相连接。HOLIWORLD-Data 将这些来自约100个自采集场景的记录组织为有依据的学习资源，包括约80K个问答对，用于训练 HOLIWORLD-VL-4B。对留出记录进行独立人工标注形成 HOLIWORLD-Bench，支持评估标注质量以及学习到的空间与时间理解。在 ScanNet、ScanNet++、Aria Digital Twin 和 HOLIWORLD-Bench 上的实验展示了在静态感知和动态跟踪方面的强劲性能，而在 HOLIWORLD-Data 上训练显著提升了 HOLIWORLD-VL-4B 在 HOLIWORLD-Bench 和 EgoDynamic4D 上的空间与时间推理能力。HOLIWORLD 为从人类经验的持续流中扩展学习资源并推进机器对动态世界的理解提供了实用基础。

title: EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
summary: Reconstructing human activity from egocentric video requires more than recovering individual 3D components: the observer's motion, surrounding geometry, and hand-object interactions must fit together in a consistent world. Achieving this coherence requires both joint reconstruction and aligned supervision, yet existing methods and datasets offer limited support for either. We present EgoXperience, a full-stack paradigm that addresses these needs through data collection, automatic annotation, unified modeling, and benchmarking. Central to EgoXperience is an automatic annotation engine, EgoX-Engine, that couples geometrically verified object tracking with SLAM-based world alignment, yielding consistent supervision for the camera, scene, hands, and objects. This yields EgoX-Data-6M, a 50-hour dataset of task-driven manipulation and locomotion within and across indoor and outdoor environments, with second-level task captions. We carefully select one hour across these activity categories as EgoX-Bench to evaluate joint reconstruction. To translate this supervision into reconstruction, we introduce EgoX, trained with EgoX-Data-6M and complementary annotations from additional public datasets. Given monocular egocentric video and first-frame object masks, our model achieves joint metric reconstruction of the camera, scene, hands, and objects in a shared world coordinate frame with a single forward pass. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across scene estimation and world-space hand-object pose recovery. Against the strongest evaluated baselines, EgoX reduces camera, hand, and depth errors by 68.9%, 65.6%, and 42.9%, and improves object pose scores by 28.0%.
translation:
标题：EgoXperience：从人类经验中学习世界锚定的第一人称表征

摘要：从第一人称视频中重建人类活动，不仅需要恢复各个独立的三维组件：观察者的运动、周围几何结构以及手-物交互必须在一致的世界中相互契合。实现这种一致性既需要联合重建，也需要对齐的监督，然而现有方法和数据集对二者的支持均有限。我们提出 EgoXperience，一种全栈范式，通过数据采集、自动标注、统一建模和基准评测来满足这些需求。EgoXperience 的核心是自动标注引擎 EgoX-Engine，它将经过几何验证的目标跟踪与基于 SLAM 的世界对齐相结合，为相机、场景、手部和物体生成一致的监督。由此得到 EgoX-Data-6M，一个时长 50 小时的数据集，涵盖室内外环境内部及跨环境的任务驱动操作与移动，并带有秒级任务描述。我们仔细选取这些活动类别中共一小时的数据作为 EgoX-Bench，用于评估联合重建。为将这种监督转化为重建，我们提出 EgoX，并使用 EgoX-Data-6M 以及来自其他公开数据集的补充标注进行训练。给定单目第一人称视频和首帧物体掩码，我们的模型通过单次前向传播，在共享世界坐标系中实现相机、场景、手部和物体的联合度量重建。大量实验表明，在场景估计和世界空间手-物位姿恢复方面均达到最先进性能。与评估中最强的基线相比，EgoX 将相机、手部和深度误差分别降低 68.9%、65.6% 和 42.9%，并将物体位姿得分提高 28.0%。

title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.
translation:
标题：OpenVLHarness：具备多模态记忆的真实世界视觉智能体工具使用

摘要：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉推理方面取得了快速进展，但许多任务所需的证据难以仅通过内部推理获得：我们在22个基准上的受控研究表明，单纯增加基础模型的推理预算仅能带来有限增益。此类任务需要借助异构工具获得有据感知、外部知识和数值测量，并且必须使工具输出对模型可解释，并在各推理步骤之间得以保留。我们提出OpenVLHarness，一个围绕能力层与持久多模态记忆组织的多模态推理框架。能力层将任务级工具接口与证据渲染相结合，为异构后端提供一致访问，并将其输出转换为模型可读的观测。持久多模态记忆在每个查询过程中将相应图像、结构化数据和网页引用保留为可寻址工件。编码接口可在已存储数据上执行生成的程序，从而实现组合多个工具结果的计算。这些机制共同支持获取、检查与组合多模态证据的迭代过程。在22个基准上使用八个开放与专有骨干模型进行评估，OpenVLHarness相较匹配的无工具基线平均得分提升9.7–12.6分，其中Qwen3-VL-8B提升+11.2，Kimi K3提升+9.7，GPT-6 Astra提升+9.9。当GPT-6 Luna采用中等推理力度时，OpenVLHarness比以最大推理力度运行的基础模型、Codex和Visual Sketchpad高7.7–8.5分，而模型token成本至多为其37%。

title: ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
summary: We study language-conditioned local navigation, where a robot must navigate to a text-specified target visible in its initial observation and stop at the described location. End-to-end navigation policies require diverse training data to generalize across scenes, yet real-robot data is costly to collect and simulated data leaves a sim-to-real gap. Internet egocentric videos offer a scalable source of real-world navigation experience. Our key insight is to learn goal-directed visual dynamics from Internet egocentric videos, and use these dynamics to support robot action generation. To this end, we propose ScaleNav, a unified world-action framework with three-stage training. We first perform instruction-conditioned video pretraining on these videos to learn how observations evolve as the camera approaches instructed targets across diverse real-world scenes. Action alignment then uses action-labeled simulated data to train the model to predict executable action chunks. Joint fine-tuning subsequently optimizes all trainable components together for navigation. ScaleNav achieves success rates of 86.5% on a single-view adaptation of Short-Horizon OVON and 94.9% on our HabitatGS-LN benchmark, outperforming the evaluated baselines on both benchmarks. We further deploy and evaluate ScaleNav on a real quadruped robot, with results supporting the model's ability to generalize to real-world navigation. Code and videos are available at https://zju3dv.github.io/ScaleNav/
translation:
标题：ScaleNav：面向语言条件局部导航的可扩展互联网视频预训练

摘要：我们研究语言条件局部导航，即机器人必须导航至其初始观测中可见的文本指定目标，并停在所描述的位置。端到端导航策略需要多样化的训练数据以跨场景泛化，然而真实机器人数据采集成本高昂，而仿真数据存在仿真到现实的差距。互联网第一人称视频为真实世界导航经验提供了一种可扩展来源。我们的核心洞见是从互联网第一人称视频中学习目标导向的视觉动态，并利用这些动态支撑机器人动作生成。为此，我们提出 ScaleNav，一个具有三阶段训练的统一世界-动作框架。我们首先在这些视频上进行指令条件视频预训练，以学习相机在多样化真实场景中接近指令目标时观测如何演化。随后，动作对齐使用带动作标注的仿真数据训练模型预测可执行动作块。联合微调进而针对导航联合优化所有可训练组件。ScaleNav 在 Short-Horizon OVON 的单视角适配版本上达到 86.5% 的成功率，在我们提出的 HabitatGS-LN 基准上达到 94.9% 的成功率，并在两个基准上均优于所评估的基线方法。我们进一步在真实四足机器人上部署并评估 ScaleNav，结果支持该模型泛化到真实世界导航的能力。代码与视频见 https://zju3dv.github.io/ScaleNav/。

title: SpecMRL: Redesign Matryoshka Representation Learning within Parametric Spectrum
summary: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is designed to support flexible representation sizes by jointly optimizing nested prefixes. While effective, this design lacks an explicit constraint to ensure that the leading portion provides a suitable compact encoding. To address this, we propose SpecMRL, which reorganizes the feature space to enable more effective prefix readout. Specifically, we extend MRL with a parameter-derived spectral basis organized with feature importance. SpecMRL otherwise follows standard MRL, with prefix readout performed in the learned spectral space. Experiments on MTEB show that SpecMRL outperforms MRL at all evaluated reduced dimensions, with larger gains under more aggressive compression. These results suggest that the learned spectral basis better prioritizes informative directions, enabling more effective representation compression. Notably, SpecMRL extends the performance frontier of MRL, surpassing full-dimensional MRL with only half the embedding dimensions.
translation:
标题：SpecMRL：在参数化谱内重新设计套娃表示学习

摘要：套娃表示学习（MRL）通过联合优化嵌套前缀来支持灵活的表示尺寸。尽管该方法有效，但其设计缺乏显式约束以确保前导部分能够提供合适的紧凑编码。为此，我们提出 SpecMRL，通过重新组织特征空间来实现更有效的前缀读出。具体而言，我们扩展了 MRL，引入一种由参数导出并按特征重要性组织的谱基。除此之外，SpecMRL 遵循标准 MRL，并在学习到的谱空间中执行前缀读出。在 MTEB 上的实验表明，SpecMRL 在所有评估的降维维度上均优于 MRL，且在更激进的压缩下获得更大增益。这些结果表明，学习到的谱基能够更好地优先考虑信息量大的方向，从而实现更有效的表示压缩。值得注意的是，SpecMRL 拓展了 MRL 的性能前沿，仅用一半嵌入维度便超越了全维 MRL。

title: OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners
summary: Can large language model (LLM) agents deliver expert-level operations research (OR) solutions directly from original client materials, without prior expert reformulation? Existing OR benchmarks typically begin with self-contained descriptions or predefined optimization tasks, underrepresenting the translation of original business materials into professionally validated solutions. We introduce OR-License, an end-to-end benchmark of 31 instances across 10 industrial scenarios from paid OR engagements totaling USD 3.68 million. It preserves original requirements, input data, deliverable formats, and information boundaries after de-identification. To study information acquisition, we introduce ORSim, a controlled client simulator that discloses business facts without supplying OR expertise. Hidden evaluation checks feasibility and compares objective quality against original expert solutions accepted by clients before benchmark construction. Deployment-Adjusted Quality (DAQ) averages expert-relative quality across instances, assigning zero to infeasible deliveries. Across 11 frontier LLMs using coding-agent harnesses, several exceed the expert reference in conditional objective quality, but none matches its DAQ; the strongest primary Claude Code configuration achieves 88.39% strict feasibility and a DAQ of 0.87 against the expert reference of 1. Client information acquisition extends beyond clarification into solution development and validation, with some later stages showing higher confirmed issue-resolution proportions. Trajectory analysis identifies formulation and implementation failures, while task-equalized research-chain completion rates range from 24% to 45% across models on evaluable tasks. These findings motivate sustained information-gap resolution, faithful problem formulation, and evidence-linked self-improvement for reliable long-horizon agents.
translation:
标题：OR-License：评估LLM智能体作为真实世界运筹学从业者的能力

摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能否直接从原始客户材料中提供专家级的运筹学（OR）解决方案，而无需事先由专家进行问题重构？现有的运筹学基准通常以自包含的描述或预定义的优化任务为起点，未能充分体现将原始商业材料转化为经专业验证的解决方案这一过程。我们提出OR-License，这是一个端到端基准，包含来自付费运筹学合作项目（总金额达368万美元）的10个工业场景下的31个实例。该基准在去标识化后保留了原始需求、输入数据、交付格式和信息边界。为研究信息获取过程，我们引入ORSim，这是一个受控的客户模拟器，可在不提供运筹学专业知识的情况下披露业务事实。隐藏评估检查可行性，并将目标质量与基准构建前客户已接受的原始专家解决方案进行比较。部署调整质量（DAQ）对各实例的专家相对质量取平均，并将不可行交付记为零分。在使用编程智能体框架的11个前沿LLM中，若干模型在条件目标质量上超过专家参考，但无一达到其DAQ；最强的Claude Code主配置实现了88.39%的严格可行性和0.87的DAQ（专家参考为1）。客户信息获取不仅限于澄清，还延伸至解决方案开发和验证，部分后期阶段显示出更高的已确认问题解决比例。轨迹分析识别出建模与实现失败，而在可评估任务上，任务均衡的研究链完成率在各模型间为24%至45%。这些发现表明，可靠的长时程智能体需要持续解决信息差距、忠实地进行问题建模，并实现与证据关联的自我改进。

title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promising potential in coding tasks, and their performance is jointly determined by the policy model and the harness that mediates their interaction with the environment. Indeed, harness and policy are mutually reinforcing and evolving only one component is suboptimal---a harness tuned for one checkpoint may not target the failure modes of an updated policy, while policy learning remains limited to the trajectories elicited by a fixed harness. In light of this, we propose Self-HPO, a recursive self-improving framework for coding agents that alternates harness and policy optimization, using the evolving policy as its own harness proposer. Specifically, in each round, the current policy first analyzes its own failures and proposes new harness candidates (H-step). The policy is then updated through reinforcement learning (RL) under the selected harness (P-step), and hard tasks identified during training form the next harness search set, keeping harness optimization targeted to the policy's evolving failure modes. Across three coding benchmarks, Self-HPO consistently outperforms harness-only and policy-only baselines, improving Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's average resolve rate from 57.8% to 64.8%, with gains generalizing to out-of-distribution settings. Further analysis shows that both optimized components retain gains even when paired with their base counterparts, while their joint gain exceeds the sum of their individual gains. Self-HPO also improves reliability (Pass@1) and expands the capability frontier (Pass@k) over the base agent. Additionally, we show that with a stronger external model (e.g., Opus 4.8) as the harness proposer, the same framework yields a further performance boost.
translation:
标题：通过运行框架-策略优化实现自进化编程智能体

摘要：大语言模型（LLM）智能体在编程任务中展现出广阔前景，其性能由策略模型与中介其与环境交互的运行框架共同决定。事实上，运行框架与策略相互强化、协同演化，仅优化其中一个组件是次优的——针对某一检查点调优的运行框架可能无法针对更新后策略的失败模式，而策略学习仍局限于固定运行框架所诱导的轨迹。鉴于此，我们提出Self-HPO，一种用于编程智能体的递归自改进框架，它交替进行运行框架优化与策略优化，并将演化中的策略作为自身的运行框架提议者。具体而言，在每一轮中，当前策略首先分析自身的失败并提议新的运行框架候选（H步）。随后，策略在所选运行框架下通过强化学习（RL）进行更新（P步），训练过程中识别出的困难任务构成下一轮运行框架搜索集，从而使运行框架优化始终针对策略不断演化的失败模式。在三个编程基准上，Self-HPO持续优于仅优化运行框架和仅优化策略的基线方法，将Qwen3.5-35B-A3B的平均解决率从57.8%提升至64.8%，且增益可泛化至分布外场景。进一步分析表明，两个优化组件在与各自的基座对应组件配对时仍能保持增益，而它们的联合增益超过各自单独增益之和。Self-HPO还在基础智能体之上提升了可靠性（Pass@1）并扩展了能力前沿（Pass@k）。此外，我们表明，使用更强的外部模型（如Opus 4.8）作为运行框架提议者时，同一框架可带来进一步的性能提升。

title: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
summary: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, enabling more effective interactive visual content creation for users. However, existing methods often exhibit noticeable drift after only a few editing turns, manifesting in two aspects: 1) unstable visual quality, with accumulating artifacts and degraded details; and 2) inconsistent image content, with unintended changes to preserved regions and prior edits. To address these challenges, we propose MT Forcing, a novel training paradigm for multi-turn image editing with unified multimodal models (UMMs) based on autoregressive diffusion. Specifically, we propose Single-Turn Distribution Matching Distillation (Single-Turn DMD), which supervises student self-rollouts with a teacher that applies cumulative edits to the source image in a single turn, providing visual-quality guidance without recursive error accumulation. Additionally, we introduce Teacher-Forcing Guidance, which supervises history-dependent transitions on reference trajectories during warmup and as a regularizer during distillation, encouraging cross-turn content consistency beyond what per-turn distribution matching alone can ensure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the multi-turn image editing capabilities of UMMs, yielding more stable visual quality and stronger cross-turn consistency.
translation:
标题：MT Forcing：迈向基于自回归扩散的稳定且一致的多轮图像编辑

摘要：多轮图像编辑旨在根据一系列指令对图像进行修改，从而使用户能够更有效地进行交互式视觉内容创作。然而，现有方法在仅经过少数几轮编辑后往往会出现明显漂移，具体表现为两个方面：1）视觉质量不稳定，伪影不断累积且细节退化；2）图像内容不一致，保留区域和先前编辑出现非预期变化。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 MT Forcing，一种面向基于自回归扩散的统一多模态模型（UMMs）的多轮图像编辑新型训练范式。具体而言，我们提出单轮分布匹配蒸馏（Single-Turn DMD），该方法利用一个在单轮中对源图像施加累积编辑的教师模型来监督学生模型的自采样轨迹，从而在不引入递归误差累积的情况下提供视觉质量指导。此外，我们引入教师强制引导（Teacher-Forcing Guidance），在预热阶段监督参考轨迹上依赖历史的转移，并在蒸馏过程中将其作为正则化项，以促进仅靠逐轮分布匹配无法保证的跨轮内容一致性。大量实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了 UMMs 的多轮图像编辑能力，获得更稳定的视觉质量和更强的跨轮一致性。

title: CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents
summary: AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks. We present CoworkEnv, a capability-guided framework for synthesizing executable training environments for AI coworkers. Workflow requirements guide task construction, and programmatic validation with feedback repair checks generated specifications and grading behavior. Teacher executions yield curated demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while student interactions provide rollouts and rewards for reinforcement learning (RL). Using these resources, we train compact PocketWorker models. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, SFT raises the mean score from 46.6 to 64.1 on Claw-Eval, including a 31.9-point gain on Multi-turn tasks. An SFT-only extension to ClawMark demonstrates applicability across coworker benchmarks. We further compare RL training dynamics across configurations that vary reward processing and credit assignment. Improving training rewards provide preliminary evidence that the constructed environments support policy optimization.
translation:
标题：[CoworkEnv：为长时程协作智能体合成训练环境]

摘要：[AI 协作智能体必须协调工具、跨轮次沟通，并在遵守工作流约束的同时对不断变化的工作区状态采取行动。为这些能力构建训练经验需要连贯的请求、服务记录、工具接口和评分检查。我们提出 CoworkEnv，一种能力引导的框架，用于为 AI 协作智能体合成可执行训练环境。工作流需求指导任务构建，带反馈修复检查的程序化验证生成规格与评分行为。教师执行产生用于监督微调（SFT）的精选演示，而学生交互提供用于强化学习（RL）的 rollout 与奖励。利用这些资源，我们训练紧凑型 PocketWorker 模型。对于 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，SFT 在 Claw-Eval 上将平均得分从 46.6 提升至 64.1，其中 Multi-turn 任务提升 31.9 分。仅使用 SFT 扩展到 ClawMark 表明其适用于协作智能体基准。我们进一步比较在改变奖励处理和信用分配的配置下的 RL 训练动态。训练奖励的提升初步表明所构建环境支持策略优化。]

title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
summary: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.
translation:
标题：AnyGoal：论世界模型在专家轨迹之外的泛化

摘要：世界模型的目标是刻画环境的动力学。这具有很大的吸引力，因为它使智能体能够借助世界模型来规划和模拟一系列动作。然而，要使这些用途可靠，学习到的动力学必须在专家轨迹中所观察到的特定状态-动作组合之外也表现良好。尽管如此，数据覆盖、动力学泛化与下游规划性能之间的关系仍缺乏充分探索。我们通过组合泛化的视角研究这一关系：世界模型能否将熟悉的状态因素和动作因素重新组合为有效的动力学？为回答这一问题，我们提出了 AnyGoal，一个基于广泛使用的世界模型环境构建的目标偏移任务变体基准，并附带一个开源库。每个任务都被设计为处于已学习底层动力学的世界模型能力范围之内：各个状态因素和动作仍处于其训练支撑集内，但它们的组合在专家轨迹中代表性不足。在多种环境和世界模型族上，我们发现当前模型在这些重组情形下 consistently 表现出失败。通过考察不同模型族、交互模式和评估指标下的动力学失败与表征失败，我们研究了当前世界模型在何处能够泛化，以及在目标偏移预测与规划方面仍存在哪些挑战。总之，该框架、基准和分析为评估面向可泛化到新规划任务的世界模型的研究进展提供了基础。

title: RoAR-VAE: Improving Latent Diffusability through Robust Prediction
summary: An effective visual tokenizer must preserve image fidelity while producing latents that downstream diffusion models can learn efficiently. Prior work improves latent diffusability through semantic alignment or joint tokenizer--diffusion training. Revisiting REPA-E, a representative approach, we find that removing its diffusion objective and dedicated generative blocks while retaining semantic prediction from corrupted latents yields comparable downstream generation performance under a matched setting. This observation motivates a general principle of robust prediction: generation-relevant information should remain recoverable from corrupted latents. We instantiate this principle with two complementary objectives. RobustAlign predicts pretrained semantic features from corrupted latents to preserve high-level structure, while RobustRecon reconstructs the clean image to retain fine-grained spatial and appearance information. Together, they form Robust Alignment and Reconstruction VAE (RoAR-VAE). Our analysis suggests that robust prediction improves diffusability by making useful information more accessible in high-variance latent directions, which diffusion models tend to learn earlier. Empirically, RoAR-VAE improves average generation benchmark performance by 2.19 points over the strongest baseline tokenizer under the same training budget, while improving small-text reconstruction accuracy by 16.93 percentage points over FLUX.1-VAE. These results demonstrate that RoAR-VAE achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction fidelity and downstream generative learnability.
translation:
标题：RoAR-VAE：通过鲁棒预测提升潜在可扩散性

摘要：有效的视觉分词器必须在保持图像保真度的同时，生成下游扩散模型能够高效学习的潜在表示。已有工作通过语义对齐或分词器—扩散模型联合训练来提升潜在可扩散性。重新审视代表性方法 REPA-E 后，我们发现：在匹配设置下，去除其扩散目标与专用生成模块，同时保留从受损潜在表示进行语义预测，可获得相当的下游生成性能。这一观察引出了鲁棒预测的一般原则：与生成相关的信息应能够从受损潜在表示中恢复。我们以两个互补目标实例化该原则。RobustAlign 从受损潜在表示预测预训练语义特征，以保留高层结构；RobustRecon 重建干净图像，以保留细粒度空间与外观信息。二者共同构成 Robust Alignment and Reconstruction VAE（RoAR-VAE）。我们的分析表明，鲁棒预测通过使有用信息在高方差潜在方向上更易获取来提升可扩散性，而扩散模型往往更早学习这些方向。实验上，在相同训练预算下，RoAR-VAE 相较最强基线分词器将平均生成基准性能提升 2.19 分，同时相较 FLUX.1-VAE 将小文本重建准确率提升 16.93 个百分点。这些结果表明，RoAR-VAE 在重建保真度与下游生成可学习性之间取得了良好平衡。

title: InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation
summary: Procedural generation plays a key role in synthetic data creation and game development, offering greater controllability, editability, and diversity than static mesh representations. However, VLM-based code generation often produces relatively simple 3D assets, while sophisticated photorealistic procedural systems require extensive manual development. Existing VLM-guided procedural methods remain largely constrained by predefined factories and APIs, limiting their ability to create novel asset types. We introduce InfiniDream, a VLM-driven framework for open-ended procedural 3D world generation. First, we propose Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation, which leverages existing procedural algorithms to create novel, photorealistic assets while preserving editability and seed-based diversity. Second, we develop an end-to-end text-to-world pipeline that combines semantic scene planning with Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement to construct large-scale 3D worlds with precise object placement, procedural population, and animation. Extensive evaluations on 100 object and 20 scene generation tasks demonstrate improvements across four perceptual metrics. Diversity analysis, ablation studies, and human preference evaluations further validate the effectiveness of our framework. Project page: https://yichuanh.github.io/infinidream-page/
translation:
标题：InfiniDream：通过程序化生成开放式照片级真实3D世界

摘要：程序化生成在合成数据创建和游戏开发中起着关键作用，与静态网格表示相比，它提供了更好的可控性、可编辑性和多样性。然而，基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的代码生成通常产生相对简单的3D资产，而成熟的照片级真实程序化系统需要大量人工开发。现有的由VLM引导的程序化方法在很大程度上仍受限于预定义的工厂和API，限制了其创建新颖资产类型的能力。我们提出InfiniDream，一个由VLM驱动的开放式程序化3D世界生成框架。首先，我们提出符号约束资产生成，利用现有程序化算法创建新颖的照片级真实资产，同时保持可编辑性和基于种子的多样性。其次，我们开发了一个端到端的文本到世界流水线，将语义场景规划与确定性视锥引导网格放置相结合，以构建具有精确对象放置、程序化填充和动画的大规模3D世界。在100个对象和20个场景生成任务上的广泛评估表明，在四个感知指标上均有提升。多样性分析、消融研究和人类偏好评估进一步验证了我们框架的有效性。项目页面：https://yichuanh.github.io/infinidream-page/

title: Interlock: From Local Correctness to Task Completion in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Large language model agents increasingly undertake long-horizon tasks in complex environments characterized by fragmented evidence, partially completed states, and dependencies across resources and artifacts. Existing agents may satisfy individual requirements while failing to maintain these relationships, producing locally correct but incomplete outcomes. These failures arise because task completion depends on relationships among environmental evidence, consequential decisions, and required effects. To address this completion gap, we propose Interlock, a framework for task synthesis that represents each task as a typed completion graph. Grounding edges connect public evidence to decisions, coupling hyperedges impose joint constraints across components, and realization edges connect decisions to all required downstream effects. Interlock compiles this graph into a resettable workspace, a public request, and an evaluation rubric. A source-coverage review checks whether the original requirements survive generation, while a public-input review checks whether the rubric is supported by the materials available to the solver. An agent-as-judge inspects execution artifacts and runs verification scripts, retaining trajectories judged to satisfy all mandatory requirements. To evaluate training utility, we fine-tune two Qwen3.6 backbones on their own accepted trajectories. Across the two backbones, training improves AutomationBench task pass rates by 4.00-4.50 percentage points, JobBench weighted scores by 3.20-6.64 points, and Harvey LAB criterion pass rates by 3.89-4.16 percentage points. These results demonstrate the training utility of the synthesized experience across external task environments.
translation:
标题：Interlock：长时程智能体从局部正确性到任务完成

摘要：大语言模型智能体越来越多地在复杂环境中承担长时程任务，这些环境的特征是证据碎片化、状态部分完成以及资源与产物之间存在依赖关系。现有智能体可能满足单个需求，却未能维持这些关系，从而产生局部正确但不完整的结果。这些失败的出现是因为任务完成依赖于环境证据、 consequential决策与所需效果之间的关系。为弥补这一完成度缺口，我们提出Interlock——一个将每个任务表示为类型化完成图的任务合成框架。接地边将公开证据与决策相连，耦合超边在各组件之间施加联合约束，实现边将决策与所有所需的下游效果相连。Interlock将该图编译为可重置工作区、公开请求和评估量表。来源覆盖审查检查原始需求在生成过程中是否得以保留，公开输入审查则检查评估量表是否得到求解器可用材料的支持。智能体作为评判者检查执行产物并运行验证脚本，保留被判定满足所有强制要求的轨迹。为评估训练效用，我们在各自被接受的轨迹上对两个Qwen3.6基座模型进行微调。在两个基座模型上，训练使AutomationBench任务通过率提升4.00-4.50个百分点，JobBench加权分数提升3.20-6.64分，Harvey LAB标准通过率提升3.89-4.16个百分点。这些结果证明了合成经验在外部任务环境中的训练效用。

title: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
summary: We propose KronLSTM, a linear attention architecture based on the Kronecker Delta Rule, a novel update rule for associative matrix memories. KronLSTM extends the xLSTM family with a memory-revision mechanism that corrects targeted associations while modifying the memory only along a single direction in matrix space. This minimally invasive memory revision reduces interference with previously stored information compared with delta-rule updates, making it particularly well suited for long-context language modeling. The resulting memory dynamics can be mathematically described as a Markov chain that converges to a steady-state distribution, while the expected norm of the memory matrix remains uniformly bounded throughout the entire input sequence. Hence, KronLSTM ensures stable memory dynamics without requiring additional normalization and stabilization mechanisms for the memory state. Experiments show that KronLSTM is competitive with, and often outperforms, existing linear attention architectures, including models of the (Gated) DeltaNet family, with particularly strong performance on long context benchmarks. These results establish the Kronecker Delta Rule as an effective and analytically tractable foundation for stable associative memory in recurrent linear attention architectures. Our code (https://github.com/NX-AI/KronLSTM) and models (https://huggingface.co/collections/NX-AI/kronlstm) are open-source.
translation:
标题：长上下文线性注意力的克罗内克δ规则

摘要：我们提出KronLSTM，一种基于克罗内克δ规则的线性注意力架构；该规则是一种用于联想矩阵记忆的新型更新规则。KronLSTM扩展了xLSTM家族，引入一种记忆修订机制，该机制能够纠正目标关联，同时仅在矩阵空间的单一方向上修改记忆。与delta规则更新相比，这种最小侵入式记忆修订减少了对先前存储信息的干扰，使其特别适合长上下文语言建模。由此产生的记忆动态可在数学上描述为收敛至稳态分布的马尔可夫链，而记忆矩阵的期望范数在整个输入序列中始终保持一致有界。因此，KronLSTM确保了稳定的记忆动态，而无需为记忆状态引入额外的归一化与稳定化机制。实验表明，KronLSTM与现有线性注意力架构（包括(Gated) DeltaNet家族模型）相比具有竞争力，且往往优于后者，在长上下文基准上表现尤为强劲。这些结果确立了克罗内克δ规则作为循环线性注意力架构中稳定联想记忆的有效且解析上可处理的基础。我们的代码（https://github.com/NX-AI/KronLSTM）和模型（https://huggingface.co/collections/NX-AI/kronlstm）已开源。

title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
summary: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic manner, which can incur unnecessary preprocessing cost and discard details that later prove essential. Recent studies have begun shifting memory processing toward runtime adaptation, but typically specialize in particular operations or fixed processing schemes, leaving flexible control over performance, cost, and latency largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we present MemPilot, a flexible framework that orchestrates on-demand memory curation under different performance--cost--latency preferences. Specifically, we optimize a multi-step LLM policy via reinforcement learning to iteratively choose between retrieving from query-agnostic memory and delegating query-specific curation of raw multimodal history to heterogeneous LLMs and VLMs. The policy jointly controls evidence amount, curation instructions, model selection, and visual access, enabling fine-grained allocation of runtime computation. To optimize this policy under competing objectives, we adapt objective-wise advantage decoupling by separately estimating each objective's advantage before aggregation. Moreover, we introduce prefix-based marginal utility estimation for fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step rollouts. Experiments on five multimodal agent-memory benchmarks demonstrate favorable performance--cost--latency trade-offs across optimization preferences, with preference sweeps yielding broader frontiers than existing trade-off-aware baselines.
translation:
标题：MemPilot：为LLM智能体编排按需多模态记忆整理

摘要：记忆已成为LLM智能体生态不可或缺的组成部分，支持跨交互的信息保留与复用。然而，现有大多数智能体记忆系统以查询无关的方式构建记忆，这可能导致不必要的预处理成本，并丢弃后续被证明至关重要的细节。近期研究已开始将记忆处理转向运行时自适应，但通常局限于特定操作或固定处理方案，对性能、成本和延迟的灵活控制在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。为应对这一挑战，我们提出MemPilot，一个灵活的框架，可在不同的性能—成本—延迟偏好下编排按需记忆整理。具体而言，我们通过强化学习优化一个多步LLM策略，使其迭代地在从查询无关记忆中检索与将面向特定查询的原始多模态历史整理委托给异构LLM和VLM之间进行选择。该策略联合控制证据数量、整理指令、模型选择和视觉访问，从而实现运行时计算的细粒度分配。为在相互竞争的目标下优化该策略，我们采用按目标优势解耦，在聚合之前分别估计每个目标的优势。此外，我们引入基于前缀的边际效用估计，用于跨多步rollout的细粒度信用分配。在五个多模态智能体记忆基准上的实验表明，该框架在不同优化偏好下均实现了良好的性能—成本—延迟权衡；偏好扫描所产生的前沿比现有权衡感知基线更宽。

title: Manga2Animate: An Agentic Framework for Faithful Manga Animation with Script and Storyboard Planning
summary: Adapting existing manga into coherent animation that stays faithful to the source is a valuable yet challenging task. Existing methods either access the manga mainly through text, losing its characters and art style, or feed manga pages directly into video generation models, which misinterpret the manga's structure and produce incorrect storylines. In this paper, we propose Manga2Animate, a multi-agent framework that grounds every stage of generation in the source manga. We decompose the task into two intermediate representations, an animation script and a visual storyboard. Each representation is produced by a creator agent and reviewed against the source panels by a paired reviewer agent. We tailor representation-specific selection and dual-level feedback to progressively refine both before synthesizing the final animation. Extensive experiments and a user study demonstrate that Manga2Animate produces animations more faithful to the source manga and more consistent across shots than state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://annchenn.github.io/Manga2Animate/
translation:
标题：Manga2Animate：一个结合剧本与分镜规划、面向忠实漫画动画化的智能体框架

摘要：将现有漫画改编为连贯且忠实于原作的动画是一项有价值但颇具挑战性的任务。现有方法要么主要通过文本获取漫画信息，从而丢失角色与艺术风格；要么将漫画页面直接输入视频生成模型，而这些模型会误解漫画结构并生成错误的故事情节。本文提出 Manga2Animate，一个多智能体框架，将生成的每个阶段都以源漫画为依据。我们将该任务分解为两种中间表示：动画剧本和视觉分镜。每种表示由创建者智能体生成，并由配对的审核者智能体对照源漫画分格进行审查。我们定制了针对特定表示的选择机制和双层反馈，以在合成最终动画之前逐步细化二者。大量实验和用户研究表明，与最先进方法相比，Manga2Animate 生成的动画更忠实于源漫画，且镜头间一致性更高。项目页面：https://annchenn.github.io/Manga2Animate/

title: RoboValue: A Fine-Grained Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Unified Evaluation of Robotic Value Models
summary: Robotic value models assess task execution from visual observations and instructions, providing feedback for policy learning and execution monitoring. However, existing evaluations cover only selected aspects of execution understanding, leaving the reliability of value feedback insufficiently tested. We introduce RoboValue, a fine-grained sim-and-real benchmark for unified evaluation of robotic value models. Its framework evaluates four complementary capability dimensions through shared interfaces: task-state understanding, temporal progress monitoring, failure and recovery reasoning, and value consistency. Diagnostic trajectories and instruction variations test whether value judgments accurately reflect task requirements and changes throughout execution. RoboValue-Dataset covers 15 simulation and 20 real-world manipulation tasks, providing expert demonstrations for training and annotated trajectories for fine-grained evaluation. We evaluate representative robotic value models in zero-shot and one-shot settings under standard conditions and separate shifts in robot embodiment and environment. Our results reveal errors in fine-grained instruction grounding, history-dependent progress tracking, and recovery assessment, even in models with strong outcome and forward-progress scores. The same semantic subtask can also receive substantially different value gains across valid execution orders. These findings identify concrete targets for value supervision, while the dataset and public leaderboard support continued assessment of feedback reliability. The website is available at https://robovalue-benchmark.github.io/.
translation:
标题：[RoboValue：面向机器人价值模型统一评估的细粒度仿真与真实基准]

摘要：[机器人价值模型根据视觉观察和指令评估任务执行，为策略学习和执行监控提供反馈。然而，现有评估仅涵盖执行理解的某些方面，导致价值反馈的可靠性未得到充分检验。我们提出RoboValue，一个用于机器人价值模型统一评估的细粒度仿真与真实基准。其框架通过共享接口评估四个互补的能力维度：任务状态理解、时间进度监控、失败与恢复推理以及价值一致性。诊断轨迹和指令变体用于测试价值判断是否准确反映任务需求以及执行全程中的变化。RoboValue-Dataset涵盖15个仿真操作任务和20个真实世界操作任务，提供用于训练的专家演示和用于细粒度评估的标注轨迹。我们在标准条件下以及机器人具身形态和环境分别发生偏移的条件下，对代表性机器人价值模型进行零样本和单样本设置评估。我们的结果揭示了细粒度指令接地、依赖历史的进度跟踪和恢复评估中的错误，即使模型在结果与前进进度得分上表现强劲。同一语义子任务在不同的有效执行顺序下也可能获得显著不同的价值增益。这些发现为价值监督确定了具体目标，同时数据集和公共排行榜支持对反馈可靠性的持续评估。网站见 https://robovalue-benchmark.github.io/。]

title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
summary: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.
translation:
标题：物理RSI能力从何而来？——LLM作为策略的观测缩放定律

摘要：本文系统研究了物理递归自我改进的机制、缩放行为与泛化能力。我们引入PhysRSI-eval，通过五轴指标量化物理RSI：首次尝试性能、效率、成功率、预算以及失败后的改进。在固定交互预算下，我们在18个操作任务上评估了不同的视觉语言模型（VLM）。对实验结果的分析引出“物理木桶假设”：不同能力可能约束改进的不同部分。五轴指标还能区分公开基准平均值相近的系统，并表明高分未必伴随早期或高效增益。我们从两个视角研究观测缩放：根据VLM智能体的公开能力预测其相对性能，以及从早期物理反馈预测后续进展。这些分析共同考察智能体能够多快、多大程度地改进。此外，我们进行工作空间干预，并分析改进所留下的内容。移除历史会降低后期轮次成功率，冻结的工作空间在未见布局上仍然有用，三个跨任务案例更早取得成功。结果表明，场景特定适应与可复用经验可以共存。

title: AdaExploreBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Proactive Exploration and Test-time Adaptation in Evolving Environments
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in unfamiliar and evolving environments, requiring them to proactively explore, understand, and adapt to environmental dynamics. However, existing benchmarks rarely test whether agents can proactively discover how an environment works and adapt as it evolves. To address this gap, we introduce AdaExploreBench, a benchmark for proactive exploration and test-time adaptation in evolving environments. By instantiating environmental dynamics as hidden rules, AdaExploreBench requires agents to actively acquire evidence and infer the rules. Under implicit rule drift, the latent rule changes without announcement, requiring agents to detect from degraded performance that prior knowledge is stale and re-explore. Experiments on eight leading LLMs show that proactive and adaptive exploration remain challenging: GPT-6 Sol achieves only 61.9% calibrated accuracy, while providing sufficient evidence or removing rule drift improves average performance significantly by close to 10%. These results reveal a critical bottleneck in current LLM agents: they can often reason effectively from informative evidence once it is available, but struggle to actively acquire the right evidence and recognize when previously acquired evidence is no longer valid.
translation:
标题：AdaExploreBench：面向演化环境中主动探索与测试时适应的大语言模型智能体基准测试

摘要：大语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地部署于陌生且不断变化的环境中，这要求它们主动探索、理解并适应环境动态。然而，现有基准很少检验智能体能否主动发现环境的运作方式，并随环境演化进行适应。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 AdaExploreBench，一个面向演化环境中主动探索与测试时适应的基准。AdaExploreBench 将环境动态实例化为隐藏规则，要求智能体主动获取证据并推断规则。在隐式规则漂移下，潜在规则会在无通知的情况下发生变化，要求智能体从性能退化中检测到先验知识已过时并重新探索。对八个领先 LLM 的实验表明，主动且自适应的探索仍具挑战性：GPT-6 Sol 的校准准确率仅为 61.9%，而提供充分证据或消除规则漂移可使平均性能显著提升近 10%。这些结果揭示了当前 LLM 智能体的一个关键瓶颈：一旦有信息量的证据可得，它们通常能够有效推理，但难以主动获取正确证据，也难以识别先前获取的证据何时不再有效。

title: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
summary: Generalizable robot manipulation requires predicting how a scene will evolve, identifying where interactions are feasible, and determining how to act. Action-labeled robot videos directly supervise control but are costly and limited in diversity, whereas egocentric human videos capture diverse interactions but lack robot actions and differ in embodiment and appearance. We introduce AffordanceWAM, an affordance-aware generative World Action Model that represents object-centric spatiotemporal affordance through Scalar Affordance and Affordance Heatmap, within the generated future World. This representation grounds visual prediction in task-relevantant objects and interaction regions for action generation, and provides shared interaction targets across human and robot videos. Built on a pretrained video diffusion Transformer, AffordanceWAM uses separately parameterized World and Action Experts, coupled through Masked Joint Self-Attention, to jointly predict future RGB observations, Scalar Affordance fields, Affordance Heatmaps, and continuous robot actions under a unified flow-matching objective. Human videos supervise all three future-World streams, whereas robot trajectories additionally provide action supervision, enabling transfer without human action labels or retargeting. Experiments on RoboCasa, CALVIN ABCrightarrowD, and real-world manipulation demonstrate consistent gains over RGB-only and robot-data-only baselines. Under fixed robot supervision, RoboCasa performance improves monotonically as affordance-annotated human video scales. These results support affordance as an effective interface for both vision-language-action learning and human-to-robot transfer.
translation:
标题：AffordanceWAM：面向机器人操作的可供性感知联合世界-动作建模

摘要：可泛化的机器人操作需要预测场景将如何演化、识别何处交互可行以及确定如何行动。带动作标注的机器人视频可直接监督控制，但成本高昂且多样性有限；而第一人称人类视频能够捕获多样交互，但缺乏机器人动作，并且在具身形态和外观上存在差异。我们提出AffordanceWAM，一种可供性感知的生成式世界动作模型，在生成的未来世界中通过标量可供性和可供性热图表示以对象为中心的时空可供性。该表示将视觉预测锚定到任务相关对象和用于动作生成的交互区域，并在人类视频与机器人视频之间提供共享的交互目标。基于预训练视频扩散Transformer，AffordanceWAM使用分别参数化的世界专家和动作专家，通过掩码联合自注意力耦合，在统一的流匹配目标下联合预测未来RGB观测、标量可供性场、可供性热图和连续机器人动作。人类视频监督全部三个未来世界流，而机器人轨迹额外提供动作监督，从而无需人类动作标签或重定向即可实现迁移。在RoboCasa、CALVIN ABC→D和真实世界操作上的实验表明，该方法相较于仅RGB和仅机器人数据的基线取得了一致提升。在固定机器人监督下，随着带可供性标注的人类视频规模增加，RoboCasa性能单调提升。这些结果支持可供性作为视觉-语言-动作学习和人类到机器人迁移的有效接口。

title: FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) promises instant scene reconstruction with high-quality novel-view synthesis. Yet, fine-grained geometry and appearance remain difficult to recover, motivating us to revisit how feed-forward models represent, aggregate, and refine detailed visual information. We introduce FineSplat, a feed-forward 3DGS framework built around fine-grained image patches. Since global multi-view attention becomes prohibitively expensive at such high token resolutions, we develop a dual-grouping strategy that combines two complementary forms of locality: view-wise grouping enables efficient interaction among neighboring views, while 3D spatial grouping reconnects geometrically related tokens that may never have interacted under view-wise grouping by lifting them into the 3D scene space. We further leverage reconstruction error as direct feedback, providing an explicit rendering-based signal to recover fine-grained structures and appearance, thereby overcoming the limitations of one-pass feed-forward prediction. Finally, a compact Gaussian generation scheme preserves the benefits of fine-grained features without unnecessarily increasing the number of primitives. Together, these designs enable FineSplat to recover richer geometry and appearance while remaining efficient and compact, achieving state-of-the-art results by a substantial margin, under the same or smaller Gaussian budgets than existing methods.
translation:
标题：FineSplat：精细图块、局部组与细节泼溅

摘要：前馈三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）有望实现即时场景重建与高质量新视角合成。然而，细粒度几何与外观仍难以恢复，这促使我们重新审视前馈模型如何表示、聚合和细化细节视觉信息。我们提出 FineSplat，一个围绕细粒度图像块构建的前馈 3DGS 框架。由于在如此高的 token 分辨率下，全局多视角注意力变得过于昂贵，我们设计了一种双分组策略，结合两种互补的局部性形式：按视角分组可在相邻视角之间实现高效交互，而三维空间分组则通过将几何相关的 token 提升到三维场景空间，重新连接那些在按视角分组下可能从未交互过的 token。我们进一步利用重建误差作为直接反馈，提供显式的基于渲染的信号来恢复细粒度结构与外观，从而克服单次前馈预测的局限性。最后，一种紧凑的高斯生成方案保留了细粒度特征的优势，同时避免不必要地增加基元数量。这些设计共同使 FineSplat 能够恢复更丰富的几何与外观，同时保持高效紧凑，并在与现有方法相同或更小的高斯预算下以显著优势取得最先进的结果。

title: Evidence-First Agentic Verification
summary: Long-horizon, semi-verifiable agentic tasks often rely on rubric-based evaluation, but the evidence needed to assess these tasks can be spread across the environment state and the execution trace. A judge may overlook this evidence or accept unsupported claims, including an agent's own reports of success. When rubric verdicts serve as reinforcement-learning rewards, such errors can reinforce undesirable behavior. We introduce Sauron, an evidence-first agentic verifier that investigates both state and trace and relies on a claim only after independently validating it against its source. Bounded queries and joint investigation of related criteria reduce context use and redundant work, and each verdict carries an auditable receipt of its supporting evidence. Across 2,586 human-labeled criteria from 100 personal-assistant episodes, Sauron achieves the highest F1 of five verifiers on all eight backbones tested while costing less than Gandalf, the strongest baseline. With GPT-5.6 Sol, it reaches 0.96 F1 versus Gandalf's 0.92 at 23% lower cost, with a wider margin on process criteria. On a paired fault-injection suite covering 13 families, several of which simulate reward hacking, Sauron detects 97% of injected failures while flagging only 2% of clean controls, outperforming baselines even when they are given the full trace. On TRAIL, a benchmark for detecting and localizing real agent errors, Sauron leads both Gandalf and TRAIL's own judge on all three quality metrics.
translation:
标题：证据优先的智能体验证

摘要：长时程、部分可验证的智能体任务通常依赖基于评分细则的评估，但评估这些任务所需的证据可能分散在环境状态和执行轨迹中。评判者可能忽略这些证据，或接受缺乏支持的声明，包括智能体自身对成功的报告。当评分细则的判定被用作强化学习奖励时，此类错误可能强化不良行为。我们提出 Sauron，一种证据优先的智能体验证器，它同时调查状态与轨迹，并且只有在将某项声明与其来源独立验证后才采信该声明。有界查询以及对相关标准的联合调查减少了上下文使用和重复工作，且每个判定都附带其支持证据的可审计回执。在来自100个个人助理回合的2,586个人工标注标准上，Sauron在测试的全部八个骨干模型上均取得五种验证器中最高的F1，同时成本低于最强基线Gandalf。使用GPT-5.6 Sol时，它以低23%的成本达到0.96 F1，而Gandalf为0.92，在过程标准上优势更明显。在涵盖13类故障（其中若干类模拟奖励劫持）的配对故障注入套件上，Sauron检测到97%的注入失败，同时仅将2%的干净对照误标，即使向基线提供完整轨迹也仍优于基线。在用于检测和定位真实智能体错误的基准TRAIL上，Sauron在三项质量指标上均领先于Gandalf和TRAIL自带的评判器。

title: Think Visually Across Space and Time: Grounded Reasoning for Video Segmentation
summary: Video Reasoning Segmentation (VRS) requires a model to identify an implicitly described target and predict its pixel-level mask trajectory, while resolving the spatial relations and temporal events that determine the answer. Text-only Chain-of-Thought (CoT) can explain a target choice without making the underlying visual references explicit, leaving a video reference gap between linguistic inference and the evidence distributed across frames. We introduce Temporal Chain of Video Primitives (TCoVP), a spatiotemporally grounded form of Video CoT that organizes query-relevant observations into a chronological reasoning chain. Each primitive associates an entity reference with temporal support and timestamped spatial evidence, and the chain interleaves these references with language to guide reasoning about which entity is relevant, when the queried event holds, and where its evidence appears. The selected target primitives then provide box prompts and temporal support for video mask prediction. We construct TCoVP-SFT-15k and TCoVP-RL-13k to learn this representation through supervised fine-tuning and chain-aligned reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across five VRS benchmarks and three model backbones demonstrate the strong performance of TCoVP, highlighting the effectiveness of organizing spatial and temporal evidence within the reasoning process. All models and code will be publicly released. Project page: https://victor-wjw.github.io/TCoVP/
translation:
标题：跨时空的视觉思考：面向视频分割的接地推理

摘要：视频推理分割（VRS）要求模型识别隐含描述的目标并预测其像素级掩码轨迹，同时解析决定答案的空间关系和时间事件。纯文本思维链（CoT）能够解释目标选择，却无法将底层的视觉指代表达明确化，从而在语言推理与分散于各帧中的证据之间留下了视频指代鸿沟。我们提出时序视频基元链（TCoVP），这是一种时空接地的视频思维链形式，它将与查询相关的观察组织为按时间顺序排列的推理链。每个基元将实体指代与时间支撑及带时间戳的空间证据相关联，该链条将这些指代与语言交织在一起，以引导对以下问题的推理：哪个实体是相关的、所查询的事件何时成立、以及其证据出现在何处。随后，被选中的目标基元为视频掩码预测提供框提示和时间支撑。我们构建了TCoVP-SFT-15k和TCoVP-RL-13k，通过监督微调和链对齐强化学习来学习这一表示。在五个VRS基准和三个模型骨干上的大量实验证明了TCoVP的强劲性能，凸显了在推理过程中组织空间和时间证据的有效性。所有模型和代码将公开发布。项目页面：https://victor-wjw.github.io/TCoVP/

title: DeOverlay: A Benchmark and Source-Anchored Flow for Video Overlay Removal
summary: Video overlay removal aims to recover scenes obscured by subtitles, titles, and logos while preserving surrounding content. Existing methods use temporal propagation or source-conditioned generation, but can leave residual overlays and distort scene structure when useful source information is obscured. We propose DeOverlay, a source-anchored flow model that reconstructs the clean video from the source latent with fixed source guidance. Specifically, we train a shared velocity network along paired source-to-clean paths using region-weighted flow matching, enabling successive cor- rections from intermediate states. To select local source cues, we develop visibility-normalized temporal aggregation that excludes masked positions and averages the remaining observations. Global source context and edit-region embeddings complement these cues through additive condi- tioning, retaining a single video-token sequence. To evaluate scene recovery across diverse overlay conditions, we introduce DVTE-Bench, comprising 1,631 paired videos across eight text-overlay categories, with OCR-screened clean targets, frame-aligned pixel masks, and a common evaluation protocol. Experiments on the complete release show that DeOverlay outperforms four baselines on all five reconstruction and perceptual metrics, reducing Mask LPIPS and Mask VFID by 58.3% and 70.3%, respectively, relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. Additional qualitative examples demonstrate the removal of graphic logos and stickers. We will make the complete benchmark, evaluation code, and test outputs availabl. Project page:https://yahooo-m.github.io/DVTE-Bench/
translation:
标题：DeOverlay：视频叠加层去除的基准与源锚定流

摘要：视频叠加层去除旨在恢复被字幕、标题和徽标遮挡的场景，同时保留周围内容。现有方法采用时序传播或源条件生成，但当有用的源信息被遮挡时，可能残留叠加层并扭曲场景结构。我们提出 DeOverlay，一种源锚定流模型，在固定源引导下从源潜变量重建干净视频。具体而言，我们沿成对的源到干净路径，使用区域加权流匹配训练共享速度网络，从而能够从中间状态进行连续校正。为选择局部源线索，我们开发了可见性归一化时序聚合，该聚合排除被掩码位置并对剩余观测取平均。全局源上下文和编辑区域嵌入通过加性条件补充这些线索，并保留单一视频 token 序列。为评估多样叠加条件下的场景恢复，我们引入 DVTE-Bench，包含跨八种文本叠加类别的 1,631 对视频，配有经 OCR 筛查的干净目标、帧对齐像素掩码和统一评估协议。在完整发布版本上的实验表明，DeOverlay 在全部五项重建和感知指标上优于四个基线；相对于评估中最强基线，Mask LPIPS 和 Mask VFID 分别降低 58.3% 和 70.3%。额外的定性示例展示了图形徽标和贴纸的去除。我们将公开完整基准、评估代码和测试输出。项目页面：https://yahooo-m.github.io/DVTE-Bench/

title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
summary: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro
translation:
标题：HarnessPro：基于帕累托优化的递归框架自我改进以实现性能-成本权衡

摘要：框架开发对于构建能力强大的AI智能体至关重要。近期的方法通过递归自我改进（RSI）来改进框架，但其性能提升往往伴随着更高的执行成本。我们提出HarnessPro，一种无标签的方法，用于演化框架以提升任务性能的同时降低执行成本。在此设定下，候选框架使用LLM生成的测试进行评估，而无法访问真实答案或官方测试。专用智能体诊断执行轨迹，以不同的性能-成本优先级规划更新，并将其实现为候选框架。HarnessPro并非返回单一框架，而是使用归一化加权平方距离选择，为不同的部署预算提供成本优先（lite）、均衡（medium）和性能优先（heavy）三种框架。选定的框架进入下一次迭代，由执行反馈指导进一步的更新。我们的实验涵盖Terminal-Bench 2、SWE-Bench Pro和ProgramBench，使用GPT-5.5配合Codex以及GLM-5.2配合Claude Code。在这些基准测试中，使用GPT-5.5配合Codex时，HarnessPro的heavy模式相对于RHO实现了平均通过率提升2.0个百分点，平均单任务成本降低26.1%。这一优势在使用GLM-5.2配合Claude Code时同样成立。代码可在https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro获取。

title: BlenderWorld: Benchmarking Visual Agents for 3D Creation from Real-World References
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled them to act as autonomous agents, creating and editing 3D models via code or direct software manipulation. In practical workflows, these models must infer object shapes, materials, spatial layouts, and lighting from diverse references while strictly following instructions to reconstruct, modify, or design 3D content. However, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of such open-ended requests across real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce BlenderWorld, the first comprehensive benchmark dedicated to evaluating frontier models on realistic 3D creation tasks. BlenderWorld comprises 223 tasks spanning architecture, products, natural environments, and scientific visualization, driven by text, image, video, and structured specification inputs. To rigorously assess these complex deliverables, we establish a unified evaluation protocol: we render the submitted Blender projects from multiple viewpoints and evaluate them against 2,651 task-specific binary rubrics alongside holistic visual quality scores. Benchmarking thirteen frontier models reveals that GPT-6-Astra achieves the highest overall fused score of 79.9, followed by Opus-5 (73.0) and GPT-5.6-Sol (67.7). Ultimately, our findings reveal a critical bottleneck: while current models can parse broad instructions, they still profoundly struggle with fine-grained 3D spatial coherence and accurate structural reproduction in Blender, leaving substantial headroom for future 3D-native agentics.
translation:
标题：BlenderWorld：面向真实世界参考的3D创建视觉智能体基准测试

摘要：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的最新进展使其能够作为自主智能体，通过代码或直接软件操作来创建和编辑3D模型。在实际工作流程中，这些模型必须从多样化的参考中推断物体形状、材质、空间布局和光照，同时严格遵循指令来重建、修改或设计3D内容。然而，现有基准测试对跨真实世界场景的此类开放式请求覆盖有限。为弥补这一空白，我们推出了BlenderWorld，这是首个专门用于评估前沿模型在真实3D创建任务上表现的综合基准测试。BlenderWorld包含223项任务，涵盖建筑、产品、自然环境和科学可视化领域，由文本、图像、视频和结构化规范输入驱动。为严格评估这些复杂交付成果，我们建立了统一的评估协议：从多个视角渲染提交的Blender项目，并依据2,651条任务特定的二元评分标准以及整体视觉质量分数进行评估。对13个前沿模型的基准测试表明，GPT-6-Astra以79.9的最高综合融合分数位居榜首，其次是Opus-5（73.0）和GPT-5.6-Sol（67.7）。最终，我们的研究结果揭示了一个关键瓶颈：尽管当前模型能够解析宽泛指令，但它们在Blender中处理细粒度3D空间连贯性和准确结构复现方面仍存在严重困难，这为未来3D原生智能体留下了巨大的提升空间。

title: State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels
summary: Existing world models can generate action-conditioned video from a single image. Many focus on camera movement, allowing users to explore the generated scene. However, navigation alone does not ensure that an action follows persistent rules when its outcome depends on state that is invisible in the current frame. We present Stateful Harness, a framework that separates world evolution from video rendering to support stateful and rule-governed interaction. It maintains an evolving world state under specified rules, renders each resulting event with a frozen video model, and uses the generated clip to update the world state for the next turn. At each turn, the harness resolves the action selected by the user and compiles the resulting event into an instruction, while a preview clip from an editable 3D scene provides spatial and camera guidance. To evaluate rule compliance, we build WorldState-Bench, a benchmark of 50 counterfactual twin pairs that share an initial frame and action but differ in hidden state and required outcome. Under rule-only prompting, the best of the 11 evaluated video backends produces the required endings for both cases in 32% of pairs. For MiniMax-H3, specifying the required endings raises this rate from 32% to 64%, while the full harness reaches 92% with the same frozen model. These results support separating rule execution from video rendering for world interactions with hidden state.
translation:
标题：状态世界模型：执行规则，生成像素

摘要：现有的世界模型能够从单张图像生成以动作为条件的视频。许多工作聚焦于相机运动，使用户能够探索生成的场景。然而，仅靠导航并不能确保动作遵循持久规则，尤其是当动作的结果取决于当前帧中不可见的状态时。我们提出Stateful Harness，一个将世界演化与视频渲染分离的框架，以支持有状态且受规则约束的交互。该框架在指定规则下维护一个不断演化的世界状态，使用冻结的视频模型渲染每个由此产生的事件，并利用生成的片段更新世界状态以用于下一轮交互。在每一轮中，该框架解析用户选择的动作，并将由此产生的事件编译为指令，同时来自可编辑3D场景的预览片段提供空间和相机引导。为了评估规则符合性，我们构建了WorldState-Bench，这是一个包含50个反事实孪生对的基准，这些配对共享初始帧和动作，但在隐藏状态和所需结果上有所不同。在仅规则提示下，11个被评估的视频后端中最佳者在32%的配对中为两种情况都生成了所需结局。对于MiniMax-H3，指定所需结局可将这一比率从32%提升至64%，而完整框架在相同冻结模型下达到92%。这些结果支持将规则执行与视频渲染分离，以处理具有隐藏状态的世界交互。

title: Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips
summary: Streaming video world models generate the future chunk by chunk, conditioned on their own past and a stream of actions. Trained on short clips, they drift once a rollout exceeds the training horizon, as prediction errors re-enter the context and compound. A common remedy is to train the model on its own rollouts via distribution matching distillation (DMD). For action-conditioned world models, the teacher becomes a bottleneck: an external video model is agnostic to the actions, whereas the model's own pretrained network drifts in the same manner as the student. We observe that a long rollout need not match a teacher, provided it remains a realistic continuation of its own scene that follows the commanded actions. Realism and scene fidelity can be measured against real-data statistics, which remain valid at any horizon, while action following is preserved by the model's conditional generation loss. We propose Fréchet Forcing, which fine-tunes a world model together with its deployed multi-step sampler under three constraints. Generative anchoring applies the flow-matching loss after a self-generated history ending on real data. Context fidelity, a Fréchet distance (FD) on latent statistics of the free rollout centred on each clip's own ground truth, keeps every rollout faithful to its scene. Reality matching, an FD to real frames in a frozen perceptual space, keeps the generated frames realistic. Because all three targets are derived from short real clips without comparing a rollout against a long recorded future, training requires no teacher, no online critic and no long videos. Fine-tuning MiniWorld-1B, pretrained on 253-frame clips, for at most 36 GPU-hours on 381-frame clips yields rollouts that remain stable beyond 4,000 frames and continue to follow their actions in both robot manipulation and camera-controlled exploration.
translation:
标题：Fréchet Forcing：从短片段训练长时程流式世界模型

摘要：流式视频世界模型逐块生成未来，并以自身过去和动作流为条件。由于仅在短片段上训练，一旦推演超出训练时程，模型就会发生漂移，因为预测误差会重新进入上下文并不断累积。一种常见的补救方法是通过分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）在模型自身的推演上进行训练。对于动作条件世界模型而言，教师模型会成为瓶颈：外部视频模型对动作不敏感，而模型自身的预训练网络又会以与学生模型相同的方式漂移。我们观察到，长推演不必匹配教师模型，只要它保持为自身场景的真实延续并遵循所指令的动作即可。真实感和场景保真度可对照真实数据统计量来度量，这些统计量在任意时程上仍然有效；而动作遵循则由模型的条件生成损失保持。我们提出 Fréchet Forcing，在三种约束下将世界模型与其部署的多步采样器联合微调。生成锚定在以真实数据结束的自生成历史之后应用流匹配损失。上下文保真度是对自由推演潜在统计量计算以各片段自身真值为中心的 Fréchet 距离（FD），使每次推演忠实于其场景。现实匹配是在冻结感知空间中计算与真实帧的 FD，使生成帧保持真实。由于这三个目标均源自短真实片段，无需将推演与长时间记录的未来进行比较，因此训练不需要教师模型、在线评判器，也不需要长视频。在 253 帧片段上预训练的 MiniWorld-1B，在 381 帧片段上至多微调 36 GPU 小时，所得推演在超过 4,000 帧后仍保持稳定，并在机器人操作和相机控制探索中继续遵循其动作。

title: Harnessing Textual Refusal Directions for Multimodal Safety
summary: Safety in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) depends on unsafe multimodal data for post-training alignment or activation steering. However, such data is hard to collect, must be gathered anew for each modality, and its collection and distribution raise ethical and legal concerns. In this work, we relax this constraint and investigate whether textual refusal directions, extracted directly from the LLM backbone, generalize across modalities (i.e., image, video). Preliminary findings confirm this ability, though effectiveness is conditioned by layer selection, steering strength, and cross-modal alignment, with the latter causing safe multimodal inputs to be spuriously steered toward refusal. Building on this, we introduce Modality-Agnostic Refusal Steering (MARS), a lightweight training-free approach that injects multimodal safety without the need for multimodal safety data. MARS corrects modality misalignment via activation centering, adaptively scales steering strength within a geometrically defined trust region, and selects the optimal intervention layer, operating at the first generated token. Evaluated on five SOTA MLLMs across safety, utility, and video jailbreak, MARS achieves consistent safety gains while preserving utility up to over-refusal. MARS reveals that safety-relevant structure is shared across modalities and that textual refusal directions are a powerful and underexplored foundation for multimodal alignment.
translation:
标题：利用文本拒绝方向实现多模态安全

摘要：多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的安全性依赖于不安全的多模态数据进行后训练对齐或激活引导。然而，此类数据难以收集，且每种模态均需重新采集，其收集与分发还引发伦理和法律问题。在本工作中，我们放宽了这一约束，探究直接从LLM主干中提取的文本拒绝方向能否跨模态（即图像、视频）泛化。初步发现证实了这一能力，尽管其有效性受层选择、引导强度和跨模态对齐的制约，其中跨模态对齐会导致安全的多模态输入被虚假地引导至拒绝。在此基础上，我们提出了模态无关拒绝引导（MARS），一种轻量级免训练方法，无需多模态安全数据即可注入多模态安全性。MARS通过激活中心化纠正模态错位，在几何定义的信任区域内自适应地缩放引导强度，并选择最优干预层，在首个生成 token 处进行操作。在五种最先进的MLLM上针对安全性、效用性和视频越狱进行评估，MARS在保持效用性的同时（直至过度拒绝前）实现了一致的安全性提升。MARS揭示了安全相关结构在各模态间共享，且文本拒绝方向是多模态对齐的一个强大且尚未充分探索的基础。

title: LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints
summary: Industrial manipulation in flexible manufacturing, e.g., high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) electronics assembly, requires robot policies to adapt to changing products and production conditions. Such settings impose industrial process constraints, including product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances. However, existing evaluation frameworks do not systematically capture these constraints when assessing generalist robot policies. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Industry, a novel benchmark built on the widely used robot learning benchmark LIBERO, that translates the aforementioned industrial constraints into controllable task conditions and measurable success criteria. Specifically, LIBERO-Industry comprises three classic task scenarios: Static-to-Dynamic (S2D) loading, Dynamic-to-Static (D2S) unloading, and Dynamic-to-Dynamic (D2D) transfer. The suites contain 216 tasks in total that systematically vary object geometry, conveyor speed, interaction-window duration, and geometric acceptance region size. Extensive experiments across five generalist robot policies (including vision-language-action models and world-action models) show that performance progressively degrades as industrial constraints are introduced and combined. Under a shared fine-tuning and evaluation protocol, the LIBERO-Industry co-training condition achieved higher observed target-transfer completion than the original-LIBERO condition.
translation:
标题：LIBERO-Industry：工业过程约束下的机器人操作基准测试

摘要：柔性制造中的工业操作，例如高混合、低产量（HMLV）电子产品装配，要求机器人策略适应不断变化的产品和生产条件。此类场景施加了工业过程约束，包括产品变体、移动的物料流、有限执行窗口和严格的几何公差。然而，现有评估框架在评估通用机器人策略时并未系统性地捕捉这些约束。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 LIBERO-Industry，这是一个基于广泛使用的机器人学习基准 LIBERO 构建的新基准，将上述工业约束转化为可控的任务条件和可度量的成功标准。具体而言，LIBERO-Industry 包含三个经典任务场景：静态到动态（S2D）装载、动态到静态（D2S）卸载和动态到动态（D2D）转移。该任务套件共包含 216 个任务，系统性地改变物体几何形状、传送带速度、交互窗口时长和几何可接受区域尺寸。在五种通用机器人策略（包括视觉-语言-动作模型和世界-动作模型）上进行的大量实验表明，随着工业约束的引入和组合，性能逐渐下降。在统一的微调与评估协议下，LIBERO-Industry 协同训练条件所达到的观测目标转移完成率高于原始 LIBERO 条件。

title: Learning to Discriminate Scene Structures Makes Self-Supervised Depth Learning Scalable
summary: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation is appealing for its potential to scale with unlabeled data, yet existing methods often degrade when trained on diverse scenes. This study finds that, under self-supervision, models tend to encode dataset-specific structural biases rather than transferable scene geometry, leading to cross-domain optimization conflicts. To address this issue, this study proposes the MaSS framework, aiming to make self-supervised depth learning scalable to diverse data. MaSS introduces a dedicated structural representation pathway explicitly decoupled from contextual features, which is guided by a novel scene-structure discrimination objective to learn generalized, layout-aware structural representations for depth decoding. Trained and evaluated on four diverse datasets, both individually and jointly, MaSS substantially outperforms prior self-supervised methods and is the first to consistently benefit from mixed-domain training. Zero-shot evaluation on eight additional datasets further demonstrates its remarkable generalizability, particularly on those entirely out-of-distribution scenes. The source code is publicly available at https://mias.group/MaSS.
translation:
标题：学习判别场景结构使自监督深度学习的可扩展性成为可能

摘要：自监督单目深度估计因其随无标签数据扩展的潜力而颇具吸引力，然而现有方法在多样场景上训练时往往性能下降。本研究发现，在自监督条件下，模型倾向于编码数据集特定的结构性偏差，而非可迁移的场景几何，从而导致跨域优化冲突。为解决这一问题，本研究提出MaSS框架，旨在使自监督深度学习可扩展至多样数据。MaSS引入了一条与上下文特征显式解耦的专用结构表示路径，该路径由一种新颖的场景结构判别目标引导，以学习用于深度解码的泛化性、布局感知的结构表示。在四个多样数据集上分别及联合进行训练和评估，MaSS大幅优于先前自监督方法，并首次持续从混合域训练中获益。在另外八个数据集上的零样本评估进一步展示了其显著的泛化能力，尤其是在完全分布外的场景上。源代码已公开于https://mias.group/MaSS。

title: Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents
summary: Recursive language-model agents decompose tasks and delegate subtasks to child instances of the same policy, forming a tree of work. Training them, however, is hard: the final outcome is verifiable, but the self-invented intermediate subtasks are numerous and carry no ground truth. Existing methods score each node with a verifier or judge, which is costly at scale and blind to decomposition quality. We argue that a recursive agent must learn three coupled capabilities within one set of weights: decomposing problems into subtasks, solving them, and evaluating the outcomes, each requiring its own training signal. SERA (Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents) turns evaluation into a learned capability of the policy itself. Before delegating, the parent writes a rubric of weighted success criteria for each child subtask; a ranking objective against verified outcomes then trains rubric generation so that the criteria track genuine subtask success. In addition, a complementary leaf-coverage signal provides direct credit for task decomposition. Our central finding is that training the policy to generate aligned rubrics is what drives the gains: because the same weights both evaluate and execute, learning to judge subtasks sharpens the agent's ability to solve them. Notably, external supervision is also reduced: the judge is consulted only to train the rubric generator, while solving is trained against the agent's own rubric scores, which outperform direct use of the judge. Beyond training, the learned rubric doubles as an inference-time selector for tree search. On TextCraft-Synth and TextWorld-Sync, SERA improves over strong recursive-agent baselines by 5.38 and 13.14 points on average, and rubric-guided tree search at inference adds a further 2.43 points on TextWorld-Sync.
translation:
标题：自我评估递归智能体

摘要：递归语言模型智能体将任务分解，并将子任务委派给同一策略的子实例，形成一棵工作树。然而，训练这类智能体十分困难：最终结果可验证，但自行设计的中间子任务数量众多且缺乏真实标注。现有方法使用验证器或评判器对每个节点打分，在大规模场景下成本高昂且无法感知分解质量。我们认为，递归智能体必须在一组权重内学习三种相互耦合的能力：将问题分解为子任务、求解子任务以及评估结果，每种能力都需要各自的训练信号。SERA（自我评估递归智能体）将评估转变为策略自身的一种可学习能力。在委派之前，父节点为每个子任务编写一份由加权成功标准组成的量规；随后，一个针对已验证结果的排序目标函数训练量规生成，使标准能够追踪真实的子任务成功。此外，一种互补的叶覆盖信号为任务分解提供直接信用分配。我们的核心发现是，训练策略生成对齐的量规正是性能提升的驱动因素：由于同一组权重既执行评估又执行求解，学习评判子任务会增强智能体求解子任务的能力。值得注意的是，外部监督也得以减少：评判器仅用于训练量规生成器，而求解则针对智能体自身的量规分数进行训练，后者优于直接使用评判器。除训练之外，学习到的量规还可作为推理时树搜索的选择器。在TextCraft-Synth和TextWorld-Sync上，SERA相较于强递归智能体基线平均分别提升5.38和13.14个百分点，推理时量规引导的树搜索在TextWorld-Sync上进一步带来2.43个百分点的提升。

title: HandsOn: A Large-Scale Simulation Benchmark for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation
summary: General-purpose manipulation requires reliable behavior across embodiments, objects, and task demands. We introduce HandsOn, a composable simulation platform and benchmark for cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation. It supports five robotic arms, six dexterous hands, and approximately 200 rigid, articulated, and deformable assets in randomized scenes. The benchmark pairs 18,000 curated human demonstrations with 66 human-verified tasks: Core-50 supports demonstration-based learning and execution tests, while Transfer-16 evaluates asset and relation transfer, skill composition, and deformable manipulation without target-task training demonstrations. Qualitative real-robot rollouts illustrate sim-to-real transfer. Across diffusion, vision-language-action, world-action, and prompted VLM-based methods, the best trained multi-task policy achieves 29.1% Core-50 success. Without benchmark finetuning, GPT-6 using move_eef for palm-and-finger control achieves 5.2% on Core-50 and 1.9% on Transfer-16 over 660 trials. Trained-policy stage diagnostics expose failures in contact establishment, action coordination, and maintaining achieved goals, with additional sequencing errors in composed tasks. HandsOn provides a shared basis for investigating manipulation generalization and the limits of reliable physical interaction.
translation:
标题：HandsOn：面向可泛化灵巧操作的大规模仿真基准

摘要：通用操作需要在不同具身形态、物体和任务需求下具备可靠行为。我们提出 HandsOn，一个用于跨具身灵巧操作的可组合仿真平台与基准。它支持五种机械臂、六种灵巧手，以及随机场景中约 200 个刚性、铰接和可变形资产。该基准将 18,000 条精选人类演示与 66 个经人工验证的任务配对：Core-50 支持基于演示的学习与执行测试，而 Transfer-16 在无目标任务训练演示条件下评估资产与关系迁移、技能组合以及可变形操作。定性真实机器人运行展示了仿真到现实的迁移。在扩散、视觉-语言-动作、世界-动作以及基于提示的 VLM 方法中，最佳训练多任务策略在 Core-50 上达到 29.1% 的成功率。未经基准微调时，GPT-6 使用 move_eef 进行手掌与手指控制，在 660 次试验中于 Core-50 达到 5.2%，于 Transfer-16 达到 1.9%。训练策略的阶段诊断揭示了在接触建立、动作协调和维持已达成目标方面的失败，组合任务中还存在额外的序列错误。HandsOn 为研究操作泛化与可靠物理交互的极限提供了共同基础。

title: Factorization-Guided Training and Inference for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference through parallel verification of tokens proposed by a drafter. Diffusion drafters further parallelize proposal generation, but greater proposal capacity or higher mean accepted tokens (MAT) need not yield higher throughput. Because verification accepts only a consecutive prefix, early rejections can render later correct predictions ineffective, limiting MAT gains, while even higher MAT may not improve throughput if per-round latency increases. We introduce DScout, which uses two complementary factorizations to guide diffusion drafter training and inference for higher throughput. For training, DScout factorizes position-wise loss into inclusion, weighting, and prediction loss. This guides the design and combination of mixed-horizon training, intra-block unmasking, and acceptance-weighted loss to align supervision with prefix acceptance and improve MAT. For inference, DScout factorizes throughput as the ratio of MAT to per-round latency, guiding target-conditioning depth, drafter depth, and inference block size selection to identify a high-throughput configuration for each workload. Across six benchmarks, DScout achieves 3.84times and 4.14times mean speedups over autoregressive decoding on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, respectively, improving mean speedup over the state-of-the-art baseline by 9.1% and 7.1%. Across models and concurrency settings, our inference configuration policy provides up to 9.75% additional mean speedup over DScout's fixed configuration.
translation:
标题：因子分解引导的扩散草稿推测解码训练与推理

摘要：推测解码通过并行验证草稿模型提出的词元来加速大语言模型推理。扩散草稿模型进一步并行化提议生成，但更大的提议容量或更高的平均接受词元数（MAT）并不必然带来更高的吞吐量。由于验证仅接受连续前缀，早期拒绝会使后续正确预测失效，从而限制MAT收益；而若每轮延迟增加，即使MAT更高也可能无法提升吞吐量。我们提出DScout，它使用两种互补的因子分解来指导扩散草稿模型的训练和推理，以实现更高吞吐量。在训练方面，DScout将逐位置损失分解为包含损失、权重损失和预测损失。这指导了混合视界训练、块内去掩码和接受加权损失的设计与组合，以使监督与前缀接受对齐并提高MAT。在推理方面，DScout将吞吐量分解为MAT与每轮延迟之比，指导目标条件化深度、草稿器深度和推理块大小的选择，从而为每个工作负载确定高吞吐量配置。在六个基准上，DScout在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上分别实现了相对于自回归解码的3.84倍和4.14倍平均加速，相较最先进基线，平均加速分别提升9.1%和7.1%。在不同模型和并发设置下，我们的推理配置策略相比DScout的固定配置可提供高达9.75%的额外平均加速。

title: Remembering Has a Price: Learning Memory Worth under Resource Constraints
